# Additions
## Achievements
Achievements are earned through playing songs and doing miscellaneous tasks and can be viewed in Extras

Many achievements are earned naturally through gameplay, I'd recommend that you play through the entire story naturally first, then go back to cleanup any achievements you missed

Achievements CAN be earned in freeplay
Achievements count towards a global completion percentage
For the potato pc users out there, in a future update Discharge and Memory // Leak's achievements will be auto unlocked via a button in the options menu, since it seems in poor taste and super unfair if you can't 100% the mod because your pc is balls

# Options
- Vignette Toggle
   - located in Graphics, Vignette Toggle when unchecked prevents the rendering of the Vignette's
- Discharge Particles
   - This was already in the legacy ver. of the mod but it is now locked behind Low Memory Mode for convenience!
